question: Why does the reading on the voltmeter of a functioning galvanic cell steadily decrease over time until it reaches 0.00 V (a 'flat' battery)?
correct_answer: As the cell operates, reactant concentrations decrease and product concentrations increase, shifting the reaction toward chemical equilibrium where forward and reverse rates are equal and E_cell = 0 V.
wrong_answers_pool: The metal atoms in the wires are permanently consumed by the electric current.
The electrons lose all their charge as they travel through the resistor.
The salt bridge dries out and completely stops conducting heat.
The activation energy of the forward reaction rises to infinity.
The temperature of the cell reaches absolute zero.
The cathode loses all its protons to the voltmeter.
explanation: As reactants are converted into products, the reaction approaches chemical equilibrium (Q = K). At equilibrium, the driving force (cell potential) is 0 V.

tags.subject: Physical Sciences
tags.learning_outcome: Evaluate equilibrium and concentration effects on EMF

question: In an industrial chemical equilibrium investigation at constant temperature in a 15.6 dm³ reactor: A(g) + 2B(g) ⇌ C(g). If equilibrium yield produces 7.300 mol of product C, what would be the effect on the equilibrium concentration of C if the reactor volume is halved to 7.80 dm³?
correct_answer: The concentration of C will more than double (it increases both due to the volume halving and due to the equilibrium shifting to the right toward fewer gaseous moles).
wrong_answers_pool: The concentration of C will remain exactly the same.
The concentration of C will decrease because high pressure decomposes C.
The concentration of C will exactly double and the equilibrium position will not shift.
The concentration of C will drop to zero.
The concentration of C will halve.
The value of Kc will double.
explanation: Halving volume instantly doubles all concentrations; then, because 3 moles of gas -> 1 mole of gas, the equilibrium shifts to the right, increasing [C] even further.

tags.subject: Physical Sciences
tags.learning_outcome: Evaluate volume change on non-equimolar gas equilibrium

wrong_answers_pool: The cell voltage is LOWER than 1.10 V, because ion crowding increases internal resistance.

The cell converts into an electrolytic cell requiring external electrical energy.
The zinc electrode stops dissolving and copper begins to oxidise.
The internal resistance drops to zero permanently.
explanation: Reactant concentration [Cu²⁺] = 3.35 mol·dm⁻³ is higher than standard, and product concentration [Zn²⁺] = 0.406 mol·dm⁻³ is lower. By Le Chatelier's principle, the system shifts forward, increasing the driving potential above standard EMF (1.10 V).

question: In the Contact process, why is sulfur trioxide (SO3) dissolved into concentrated sulfuric acid (H2SO4) to form oleum, instead of being added directly to water?

wrong_answers_pool: Sulfur trioxide is completely insoluble in pure liquid water.
Direct reaction with water produces neutral hydrogen sulfide gas.
Water acts as a permanent catalyst poison that destroys V2O5.
Oleum is non-corrosive and safer to transport in wooden barrels.
Water reverses the oxidation and converts SO3 back into elemental sulfur.
Direct reaction with water freezes the absorption tower into ice.
explanation: SO3 + H2O -> H2SO4 has an extreme enthalpy of reaction that boils water into a hazardous acid fog. Dissolving SO3 in conc. H2SO4 to form oleum avoids this uncontrolled vaporization.

tags.subject: Physical Sciences
tags.learning_outcome: Explain industrial compromises using Le Chatelier
